notes: Up to v0.5.0 the kernel ignored `result`: records reporting false or null counted towards a Verified Fact exactly like records reporting true. Reported by an external reviewer (12 Oct 2026) with a reproduction against the SAFR adapter. Caps instead of stepping down, like CANON-SIG-011, so the two do not stack. Only admissible records count when a registry is loaded, so an unsigned or unregistered "false" cannot block a decision.

additional_constraints: result=false from a counted record blocks Verified Fact
policy_obligation.description: The `result` field of an Evidence Record is the producer's verdict on the asserted claim, bound into its signature: true = the producer's check supports the claim, false = the check contradicts it, null = the check gave no verdict. A Verified Fact requires at least 2 independent sources whose records report result=true, and no counted record that reports result=false. Records with result=null support nothing and contradict nothing. Otherwise the state is capped at Probabilistic Assessment, and the record ids of contradicting and verdict-less records are kept in the decision.

title: The signed result must support the claim

other_conditions: Counted records: the admissible records when a verifier registry is loaded, otherwise all records
At least 2 independent sources with result=true
required_evidence: result in {true, false, null}, covered by the record's signature

notes: Caps the state at Probabilistic Assessment instead of stepping it down, so a Record set that already failed CANON-IND-004 is not demoted twice. Protects against self-declared identities; does not protect against collusion of registered operators or a dishonest registry (see docs/sybil-design.md §7). IDs 008-010 are reserved by other drafts.

policy_obligation.description: A Verified Fact must converge on Records that are signed by keys listed in the verifier registry, not revoked, and whose signatures verify. Records of keys with the same operator, or with the same provenance root, count as one source. Records that fail these checks are not counted and are listed with a reason; they never reject the artifact. Without a registry, the state is capped at Probabilistic Assessment.

title: Evidence must be signed by a registered key

other_conditions: At least 2 independent operators after exclusion
required_evidence: Ed25519 signature by a registered, non-revoked key
